name: ImagePress – Image Gallery
author: Ciprian Popescu

sections.description:
ImagePress is a WordPress image gallery plugin for sites that want to collect and display community photos. Visitors can upload images, add a short description, and organize their work into galleries.

Use it for member galleries, photography communities, portfolios, or any site where people should be able to share images from the front end.

ImagePress includes:

  • Front-end image uploading and editing
  • Separate, sortable, and filterable galleries
  • Author profiles and portfolios
  • A responsive layout that works with your WordPress theme

Explore more WordPress Plugins.

Check out the ImagePress PRO edition for advanced image variants, detail shots, progress shots, and front-end account features.

View a free demo or learn about ImagePress PRO.
sections.installation:
1. Upload /image-gallery/ to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in wordpress
  3. Check the ImagePress menu item for images and settings
sections.faq:
How do I create my first gallery?

Install and activate ImagePress, then open the ImagePress menu in your WordPress dashboard. The plugin settings and image tools are there to help you get started.

Can visitors upload their own images?

Yes. ImagePress includes front-end image uploading so visitors can contribute images without opening the WordPress dashboard. Review your site roles and image settings before inviting visitors to upload.

Will ImagePress work with my theme?

ImagePress is designed to work with WordPress themes and uses a responsive layout so galleries adapt to phones, tablets, and desktop screens.

Can I organize images into separate galleries?

Yes. You can group images into separate galleries and let visitors filter or sort them, helping people find the images that matter to them.
